info.title: extra API
info.description:
The exm.co.il public API. Each section below is an API namespace with its own availability notes and conventions.

## Authentication

Every operation requires a Bearer token - your account API key from [/my/api/](https://www.exm.co.il/my/api/):

```http
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

A missing or invalid key returns **401** with a JSON error body (the exact envelope varies per namespace and is documented on each operation). The key grants access to the whole account - keep it server-side only; never embed it in browser or app code.

## Conventions

- ids are opaque string identifiers
- times are ISO 8601 with timezone offset (Asia/Jerusalem local), e.g. `2026-07-12T15:00:00+03:00`
- phone numbers are E.164; where a field omits the `+` (e.g. `972501234567`) the operation says so

tags.name: Authorization
tags.description:
Verify and introspect your API key

Authorization helpers for API consumers.

**Conventions**: ids are opaque string identifiers; dates are `Y-m-d`.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description:
Call history and recordings

Service page (יומן שיחות): [www.exm.co.il/features/call-log/](https://www.exm.co.il/features/call-log/)

Call-history endpoints.

Lets the authenticated account list its call history (with filtering and
cursor pagination), download a single call recording, and trade call ids
for publicly accessible recording URLs.

**Error envelope**: the calls handlers return their errors with HTTP
status **200** and `success: false` in the body (only the auth layer uses
401/403, and an unknown sub-path uses 404). The error body shape is
endpoint-specific and documented per operation:

| Endpoint | Error body |
|---|---|
| `POST /calls/` , `GET /calls/recording/` | `{ "success": false, "errors": [ { "id", "code", "description" } ] }` (array) |
| `POST /calls/get-recording-urls/` | `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message" } }` |
| Auth layer (HTTP 401/403) | `{ "success": false, "errors": { "id", "code", "description" } }` (single object) |
| Unknown sub-path (HTTP 404) | `{ "success": false, "error": { "code": 404, "description": "Path not found" } }` |

**Conventions**: all ids are opaque string identifiers (never numeric database
ids); phone numbers are E.164 (e.g. `+972501234567` in `e164` fields);
call times are local Asia/Jerusalem `Y-m-d H:i:s` strings accompanied by
`time.timezone` and `time.gmt_offset` fields.

tags.name: Click2Call
tags.description:
Customer/integration-facing Click2Call API. Trigger outbound calls on a
registered device with your account's API key.

Service page (קליק2קול): [www.exm.co.il/features/click2call/](https://www.exm.co.il/features/click2call/)

Click2Call lets a registered device (the Extra Android app, and later a
browser extension) place outbound calls triggered remotely over the API.

A device + its SIMs are first registered (app-internal), then a dial request
names which SIM to call from and the destination number; the server pushes
the dial to that device over FCM and it places the call on the named line.

tags.name: SMS
tags.description:
Send SMS messages from your verified sender IDs

SMS sending and voice phone-number verification endpoints.

**SMS** - send a text message to an Israeli mobile number from one of your
verified sender IDs. Requires an active API-SMS billing profile and a
credit card on file (pay-as-you-go).

**Verify** - verify possession of a phone number by voice call: we place
an automated call to the number, the recipient confirms by dialing a code
on the keypad during the call, and the result is POSTed to your
`callback_url`. Requires an active VERIFY_VOICE monthly billing profile.

**Conventions**: all ids are opaque string identifiers (never numeric database
ids); phone numbers are accepted in local (`050-1234567`) or E.164 form;
business errors come back as HTTP 200 with `success:false` and an `errors`
array (multiple validation errors may be returned at once).

tags.name: When
tags.description:
Booking calendars and bookings

Service page (When יומן פגישות): [www.exm.co.il/services/calendar/](https://www.exm.co.il/services/calendar/)

When appointment-scheduler endpoints.

Lets the authenticated account read its booking calendars and
bookings, and cancel a booking - the exact same flow as the UI cancel
button (slot freed, Google Calendar event removed best-effort, emails to
both sides, cancellation automation event fired).

**Availability**: the entire `/when/` namespace requires an active
**When Pro** plan on the account. Below that every endpoint returns
`403 when_pro_required`.

**Conventions**: all ids are opaque string identifiers; all times are ISO 8601 with timezone offset (Asia/Jerusalem local);
phone numbers are E.164 without `+` (e.g. `972501234567`).

get.description:
Call with no parameters to verify that your Bearer token is valid and
see what it may do. Returns the key itself, its scope grants, its
validity window and the account it belongs to.

Useful as a connectivity/credentials check before wiring a client,
and for clients that adapt to the key's scopes up front (e.g. refuse
to configure a feature the key has no scope for) instead of failing
later on a real call.

post.description:
The account's call history, newest first (`start_time DESC, id DESC`),
with filtering and opaque-cursor pagination.

**Pagination**: the response `metadata.next_page_token` is an opaque
cursor bound to the exact filter that produced it (the filter is
bound to the token). To fetch the next page, repeat the SAME
request and add the token as `pagination.next`. Changing any filter
while reusing an old token fails with error code `5010`
("Invalid next token provided: hash does not match."). A `null`
`next_page_token` means there are no more pages.

**Errors** (HTTP 200, `success: false`, `errors` array):

| code | id | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 5010 | next_token | `pagination.next` token does not match the current filter |

id.description: A single call's id - fetch just that call.

call_types.description:
Call type aliases (any of): `incoming`, `incoming_missed`,
`incoming_start`, `outgoing`, `outgoing_missed`,
`outgoing_start`. Unknown aliases are ignored.

line_types.description:
Service (line) type enums, any of: `1` = virtual number,
`2` = virtual IVR, `5` = mobile line, `7` = SIP line.

direction.description:
DO NOT USE. Accepted by the server but currently
malfunctioning: it overwrites the `line_types` filter with
call-type values instead of filtering by direction, so the
results are wrong. Use `call_types` to filter by direction
(e.g. `["incoming", "incoming_missed"]`).

time.description:
Call start-time bounds. Each bound is any strtotime()-parseable
string (e.g. `2026-07-01`, `2026-07-01 08:00:00`); unparseable
values are silently ignored.

next.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's metadata.next_page_token. Must be sent with the exact same filter.

200.description: The matching calls page - or, on a handler-level error (e.g. bad pagination token), an error body with success:false.

response_count.description: Number of calls in this response.

next_page_token.description: Cursor for the next page; null when this is the last page.

get.description:
Streams the recording file of one call (the caller's own call). On
success the response is the raw file bytes with
`Content-Type: application/octet-stream` and
`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<call id>.<ext>"`
(e.g. `zLvdabAqcT5.mp3`).

**Errors** are returned as HTTP 200 JSON with `success: false` and an
`errors` array:

| code | id | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 7010 | call_id | call_id is missing |
| 7020 | call_id | no call found (bad id, or not this account's call) |
| 7030 | call_id | the call has no recording |
| 9404 | file | failed to fetch the file from storage |

200.description: The recording bytes - or a JSON error body with success:false.

get.summary: Get the full AI object of a call
get.description:
The complete GenieAI result for one call in a single round-trip:
processing status, summary (gist, body, next steps), the custom-fields
snapshot, and the full transcription (speakers, timed segments, plain
text).

The `AI` object here is the same canonical shape delivered in the
`AI-DONE` webhook payload, with the transcription embedded.

`AI` is `null` (with `success: true`) when the call was never
AI-processed, when the id doesn't match one of the account's calls,
or when the transcript was deleted (transcripts are deleted together
with their recording; `transcription` alone is `null` then).

200.description: The AI object, or null when none exists.

next_steps.description: Follow-up items extracted from the call.

custom.description:
The line's custom-fields snapshot, keyed by field key.
Present only when custom fields were extracted.

value.description: string / number / boolean per the field's type.

type.description: Field type enum (1 int, 2 number, 3 string, 4 boolean, 5 enum).

end_ms.description: null on the last segment when unknown.

text.description: The full transcript as speaker-labeled plain text.

summary.gist: Customer asked to reschedule the technician visit.

post.summary: Get shareable URLs for call recordings
post.description:
Trades call ids for publicly accessible recording URLs, in bulk.

**TTL semantics** (`config.ttl`, minutes, required, `>= 0`):
- `ttl > 0`: returns a **signed** URL valid for that many minutes.
  Capped at 10 minutes - larger values are silently reduced to 10.
- `ttl = 0`: the recording object is made **public** (public-read,
  not time-limited) and its permanent public URL is returned.

Only calls with an actual recording of at least 1 second are matched;
every requested id still appears in the response, with per-id `code`
`0` (URL returned) or `404` (no such call for this account / no
usable recording).

**Request-level errors** (HTTP 200, `success: false`,
single `error` object):

| code | message | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Invalid ttl in config | `config.ttl` missing or negative |
| 400 | Invalid or missing ids | `ids` missing/empty |

ids.description: Call ids (non-string / empty entries are dropped).

ttl.description: URL lifetime in minutes. 0 = make public (permanent); 1..10 = signed URL for that many minutes (values above 10 are capped to 10).

200.description: Per-id URL results - or a request-level error body with success:false.

code.description: 0 = URL returned; 404 = call not found / no usable recording.

url.description: The recording URL (only when code is 0).

ttl.description: The effective TTL in minutes (only when code is 0; 0 = permanent public URL).

get.description:
Initiate an outgoing call without using the dialer GUI.

**How it works** - the call has two legs, joined once both parties
answer:
- **Leg 1**: `physical` (your device) gets an incoming call. When
  calling from a virtual/IVR number the screen shows the dialer
  number (currently `+972778040015` / `+972778050015`); otherwise it
  shows `caller_id`. The actual dialer number used is returned in
  the `numbers.dialer` field.
- **Leg 2**: when `physical` answers, `destination` gets a call
  showing `caller_id` on their screen.

**Billing notice**: the API is billing-agnostic - it makes the call
regardless of your billing preferences. Calling from a virtual
number may be priced differently from other numbers (per-minute /
minutes plan, per your account terms).

Error codes (`errors[].code`):

| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| 1010 | `caller_id` is not a valid phone number |
| 1020 | `caller_id` is not a verified number you can call from |
| 2010 | `physical` is not a valid phone number |
| 2020 | `physical` is not verified for this account (add it at /my/verified-ids/) |
| 3010 | `destination` is not a valid Israeli phone number |
| 4010 | Cannot initiate calls from `caller_id` |
| 8xxx | Database error (see description) |
| 93039 | Office hours: `caller_id` is outside its defined working hours |

parameters.name: caller_id
parameters.description: E.164 number to show on the destination's screen (usually your virtual number).

parameters.name: physical
parameters.description: E.164 number of the actual device making the call - must be verified for the account (Leg 1 rings it first).

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: E.164 Israeli number to call TO.

200.description: Call initiated (`success: true`) or a validation/initiation failure (`success: false` with an `errors` array) - business errors return HTTP 200.

alreadyDialing.summary: Duplicate request within the 45s idempotency window

errors.description: Physical number +972521234567 is not verified for this account. Add and verify it at https://www.exm.co.il/my/verified-ids/

post.description:
Sends one SMS message to `destination` from `sender`. The sender must
be one of the account's verified IDs (managed at /my/verified-ids/) with the
`sms_sender` permission granted.

**Gating** (all checked before sending; failures return HTTP 200 with
`success:false` and one error entry per failed check):
- the account must have a credit card on file (code 9404),
- the account must have an active API-SMS billing profile - having a
  pricing row also indicates the KYC forms were signed, so sending is
  allowed (code 1214),
- `sender` must be a verified ID of this account with the
  `sms_sender` flag (code 1215).

**Error codes** (in `errors[].code`):

| Code | `errors[].id` | Meaning |
|------|---------------|---------|
| 7321 | `message` | Message body is missing |
| 7526 | `destination` | Missing destination number, or invalid |
| 9404 | `payment` | No credit card on file, can't send SMS |
| 1214 | `billing` | No billing set up for this account. Contact support |
| 1215 | `sender_id` | Sender ID is not verified for this account (needs a verified ID with the `sms_sender` flag) |
| 7521 | `sender` | Sender is not verified with extra (provider-side rejection) |
| 7520 | `destination` | Destination number is not a valid textable Israeli number |
| 7462 | `destination` | Destination number is a kosher phone and can not receive text messages |
| 7404 | `NA` | Undocumented provider error (the original code is embedded in the description) |

Codes 7321-1215 are pre-send validation (may arrive several at once in
one response); 7521/7520/7462/7404 are mapped from the SMS provider after a
send attempt.

**HTTP statuses**: `200` for both success and business errors, `401`
for a missing/invalid Bearer token.

example.message: התור שלכם נקבע ליום ראשון בשעה 10:00. נתראה!

200.description:
Result of the send attempt. Check `success` - business errors also
arrive with HTTP 200.

get.description:
Returns ALL of the caller's booking calendars - active and disabled
alike (see the `active` flag). Each calendar is one bookable meeting
type with its own public URL, duration and weekly availability.

Bookings across all of the caller's calendars, sorted by start time
ascending. Filter by date range, status and calendar.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only bookings starting on/after this date (Y-m-d). Malformed value = 400.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only bookings starting on/before this date (Y-m-d). Malformed value = 400.

parameters.name: calendar_id
parameters.description:
Calendar id (from `/when/calendars/`) - only that
calendar's bookings. An id that isn't one of the caller's
calendars safely yields an empty list.

post.description:
Owner-cancels one booking. Runs the EXACT same flow as the UI cancel
button: the slot is freed, the Google Calendar event is removed
(best-effort), **both sides receive a cancellation email**, and the
`WhenMeetingCancelled` automation event fires with
`cancelled_by=owner`.

200.description: Cancelled; the updated booking is returned

404.description: Booking not found or not owned by the caller

409.description: Not cancellable (already cancelled, or already started)

BearerAuth.description: Standard Bearer token auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Use your account's API key from /my/api/ (TokensModel TYPE_API). The same key authenticates every exm.co.il API endpoint.

CallsUnauthorized.description: Missing/invalid/expired Bearer token, or blocked account

ApiBlocked.description: The account's API access is administratively blocked

C2CUnauthorized.description: Missing or invalid bearer token (the caller is unauthenticated).

WhenProRequired.description: The When API requires an active When Pro plan

error.description: The When API is available on the When Pro plan

AuthError.description: Auth-layer error envelope (`errors` is a single object here).

key.description: The API key this request authenticated with.

scopes.description: The key's per-scope grants, or `null` for a legacy/unscoped key (which may do everything the account may).

user.description: The account the key belongs to.

ErrorsArrayEnvelope.description: Handler-level error envelope used by POST /calls/ and GET /calls/recording/ - `errors` is an ARRAY of error objects. Returned with HTTP status 200.

id.description: Machine-readable error key (usually the offending field).

code.description: Numeric error code (see the operation's error table).

Call.description:
One call, as returned by the calls list. This is the same shape as
the automations webhook POST payload, plus API-only enrichments
(`numbers.own.color`, `numbers.own.line_type`, `contact.avatar`).

The `contact`, `recording` and `AI` keys are `false` (boolean) when
absent, an object when present.

event.description: Lifecycle stage - completed calls are `end`, in-progress calls are `start`.

own_type.description: What kind of line "own" is: VNUM = virtual number, VIVR = virtual IVR, MOBL = mobile line, SIPL = SIP line.

ivr_dialed.description: The IVR menu digit the caller dialed (null when not an IVR call).

duration.description: Call duration in seconds (null while the call is in progress).

note.description: The user's note on the call.

starred.description: Whether the user starred the call.

end.description: Local end time, `Y-m-d H:i:s` (absent/null while in progress).

own.description: The account's own line the call went through.

color.description: The user-assigned line color (API/app-only enrichment; null when unset).

line_type.description: API/app-only enrichment - which kind of line the call came through.

caller.description: The call's initiator. For withheld caller id both fields hold the literal string `ANONYMOUS`.

contact.description: The matched contact, or boolean `false` when the other party is not in the user's contacts.

recording.description: Recording marker: an empty object `{}` when the call has a recording, boolean `false` when it doesn't. To fetch the actual file use GET /calls/recording/ or POST /calls/get-recording-urls/.

AI.description: The GenieAI call summary, or boolean `false` when none exists.

next_steps.description: Actionable next-step items the AI extracted from the call.

recording_excluded.description: Present only on accounts enrolled in the recording-exclusions feature - true when the recording was deliberately skipped by the line's exclusion list (distinguishes "excluded" from plain "no recording").

code.description:
Stable error code. Known values: missing_device, missing_sim,
invalid_dest, device_not_found, sim_not_found, sim_disabled,
unregistered, push_failed.

description.example: Destination is not a valid Israeli phone number

call_id.description: The initiated call's id (also usable with the Calls API).

already_dialing.description: Idempotency echo. Present (true) when an identical dial - same account, same physical, same destination - is already in flight (initiated within the last 45 seconds and still ringing/connected). NO new call was placed; `call_id` is the existing in-flight call. Safe to treat as success: retrying a timed-out request returns the original call instead of dialing the destination twice.

numbers.description: The E.164 numbers actually used for the call.

dialer.description: The number Leg 1 shows on the `physical` device's screen.

ApiErrors.description:
Business/validation error envelope. `errors` is an array - several
validation failures may be reported in one response.

id.description: The offending field / machine-readable error key.

code.description: Numeric error code (see the per-operation code table).

message.description: The message body. Must be non-empty (error 7321).
message.example: התור שלכם נקבע ליום ראשון בשעה 10:00. נתראה!

destination.description:
Destination phone number - local (`050-1234567`) or E.164
(`972501234567`). Must be a valid textable Israeli number
(errors 7526 / 7520).

sender.description:
Sender identity - a phone number or an alphanumeric sender. Must
be one of the account's verified IDs with the `sms_sender`
permission (error 1215). Manage verified IDs at /my/verified-ids/.

id.description: Unique id of the SMS log record.

sent.description: Number of SMS segments the message was split into and sent.

Calendar.description: One calendar - a bookable meeting type.

active.description: Disabled calendars are hidden from the public pages but still listed here.

min_lead_minutes.description: Bookings must be made at least this many minutes ahead.

max_days_ahead.description: The public page offers slots up to this many days out.

windows.description:
Weekly availability - day-of-week keys ("0"=Sunday .. "6"=Saturday),
each an array of [start, end] time pairs.

calendar.description: The FULL calendar this booking belongs to - same shape as /when/calendars/ items, embedded so no extra call is needed to resolve it.

phone.description: E.164 without '+', empty string when unparseable.

answers.description:
The booker's answers as asked at booking time (labels are
snapshotted - later question edits don't rewrite history). Legacy
bookings fold their free-text topic into a single 'נושא' answer.

gcal_synced.description: Whether the booking currently exists in the owner's Google Calendar.
